title: Explore Broadly, Reason Sharply: Push Small Models toward the Frontier via Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2609.38104v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Power-sharpened sampling is an inference-time alternative to reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training for enhancing reasoning in large language models (LLMs). High-probability sequences are amplified under the base model without parameter updates or external rewards, avoiding the costly optimization and jagged generalization of RL. However, this approach faces a fundamental exploration--exploitation trade-off, as % strong sharpening restricts exploration, trapping samplers in plausible but incorrect reasoning trajectories, whereas weak sharpening leaves the answer distribution diffuse. translated_title: 广泛探索，精准推理：通过采样推动小模型迈向前沿
translated_abstract: 幂锐化采样是一种在推理阶段替代强化学习（RL）后训练的方法，用于增强大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力。该方法在基础模型下放大高概率序列，无需参数更新或外部奖励，从而避免了强化学习高昂的优化成本和不稳定的泛化表现。然而，这种方法面临一个根本性的探索—利用权衡问题：强锐化会限制探索，使采样器陷入看似合理但实际错误的推理轨迹；而弱锐化则会使答案分布过于分散。为解决这一权衡问题，我们提出了并行幂回火（Parallel Power Tempering, PPT），通过并行回火来实现幂锐化的LLM采样。该方法并行运行多个处于不同锐化程度且相互作用的副本，使低幂副本能够探索多样化的推理轨迹，而高幂链则进一步聚焦于更高似然的模式。
tldr: 提出并行幂回火（PPT）方法，通过在不同锐化程度下并行运行多个相互作用的副本来平衡探索与利用，使小模型无需强化学习训练、仅在推理阶段采样即可获得接近前沿的推理能力。
en_tdlr: Parallel Power Tempering (PPT) balances exploration and exploitation by running multiple interacting replicas at different sharpening levels in parallel, enabling small models to reach frontier-level reasoning purely through inference-time sampling without RL training.
